e: Thirteen structures designed by Alvar Aalto and his wives are designated as UNESCO World Heritage Sites.

Parliament votes to loosen the country's decades-old restrictions on importing or moving nuclear weapons, allowing for easier transport of such weaponry between NATO members and improving the alliance's nuclear deterrence.
Finland's Linda Lampenius and Pete Parkkonen finish sixth at Eurovision 2026 in Austria with their single "Liekinheitin".
Two Ukrainian drones stray into Finnish airspace and crash near Kouvola. One of them is destroyed in a controlled detonation by Finnish authorities.
The Supreme Court of Finland convicts Christian Democrats politician Päivi Räsänen and bishop Juhana Pohjola of hate speech against gay people. and orders Räsänen to pay a fine of 1,800 euros.

Finland boycotts the opening ceremony of the 2026 Winter Paralympics in Italy in protest over Russian athletes being allowed to compete under the Russian flag after the lifting of sanctions imposed over the Russian invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
Police arrest two people suspected of damaging a submarine telecommunications cable in the Gulf of Finland that runs between Finland and Estonia.
